notes.title: Texts and Messages!
notes.content:
Added 10 levels and 10 achievements!
A total of 20 levels and 20 achievements are available in the game!
We have added new elements and you will have to run and jump a lot.
Funny messages have appeared in the game, we want you to have fun!
We wish you good luck, patience and new emotions in the neon world.
